name: Dress
summary: Phillip Lim is a fashion designer from New York who began his fashion career with his fashion line '3.1 Phillip Lim' in 2005.  His clothing line is now represented in 26 countries worldwide. In 2007 he launched his menswear and kidswear range. Also in this year he was honoured with the CDFA Swarovsk
